note: Wave 2 of the real-world oxmysql SQL corpus. Harvested from GitHub with the same rules as oxmysql-corpus.json (wave 1) and from a disjoint set of repositories; any statement whose exact `sql` already appears in wave 1 was dropped rather than repeated. `normalised: true` means a part of the literal was built by Lua concatenation or interpolation that could not be resolved statically and was replaced with a single `?`. `alsoIn` lists the other repo/file pairs that ship the byte-identical statement. A few `sources` entries contribute zero statements: they were surveyed and found to contain no SQL at all (ox_lib, ox_target, ox_commands, ox_police, ox_fuel and several Qbox resources), or everything they did contain turned out to be a byte-identical duplicate of wave 1 or of another wave-2 repo. They are kept so the negative result is recorded rather than re-discovered.

sources.note: server.lua mixes MySQL.query.await, MySQL.query with a callback, MySQL.Sync.fetchSingle, MySQL.insert and MySQL.update in one file.

vehshop.sql is the richest ALTER TABLE source in the qb tree: ADD UNIQUE INDEX, ADD CONSTRAINT ... FOREIGN KEY ... ON DELETE CASCADE, and four ADD COLUMN migrations. server.lua also contains the only @named-parameter query in the qb corpus.
Both LIKE queries are built by Lua concatenation around a user-supplied job/gang name; the interpolated part is replaced with a single ? and the row marked normalised.
The DELETE-then-INSERT in qb-clothing:saveSkin carries a TODO explaining it only exists because playerskins has no unique key to upsert on.

migrate.sql is an INSERT ... SELECT with two UNION ALL arms and CONCAT in the projection - the only multi-arm set operation found anywhere in the qb tree. qb-inventory.sql has an inline CHECK (json_valid(...)) constraint.
Only resource found that uses :named bind parameters with a plain Lua table, including a lowercase-keyword UPDATE and an ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE that reuses the same named params.
Uses MySQL.query.await on DELETE statements purely to read back result.affectedRows as an ownership check - two of the three DELETEs mix upper and lower case AND/and in the same predicate, verbatim.
server/evidence.lua, server/interactions.lua and server/objects.lua contain no SQL at all - evidence is held in memory. server/commands.lua still uses the legacy MySQL.Async.insert.

qb-weed.sql is a real in-place column retype migration: seven data-fixup UPDATEs comparing an int column against the old string values, then ALTER TABLE ... MODIFY COLUMN. Three of the seven UPDATEs are kept as representatives.

Contains the only surviving MySQL.Async.execute call in the current qb tree, sitting next to a MySQL.update of the identical statement in the same function - good evidence that both dialects are live in one file.
Only place in the qb tree that does SELECT 1 as an existence probe (once lower-case `from`, once upper-case `FROM`) and the only column-self-reference UPDATE (drivingdistance = drivingdistance + ?).
The `dealers` table is created by no .sql file in the repo - the schema only exists implicitly in these five statements.
Fully back-quoted variant of the plate-ownership probe that qb-policejob and qb-mechanicjob write unquoted - kept deliberately as a distinct lexing case.

CREATE TRIGGER `trg_vslot_capacity_ins`
BEFORE INSERT ON `cm_house_vehicle_slots`
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    DECLARE cap INT DEFAULT 0;
    SELECT IFNULL(g.capacity, 0) INTO cap
    FROM cm_houses h
    LEFT JOIN cm_house_garage_templates g ON g.id = h.garage_template_id
    WHERE h.id = NEW.house_id;

    IF NEW.slot_index < 1 OR NEW.slot_index > cap THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
        SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'slot_index exceeds the garage template capacity';
    END IF;
END$$

CREATE PROCEDURE `john_k9_migration_0004_add_active_cert_key_column`()
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
        WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE()
          AND TABLE_NAME = 'k9_certifications'
          AND COLUMN_NAME = 'active_cert_key'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE `k9_certifications`
            ADD COLUMN `active_cert_key` VARCHAR(105)
                GENERATED ALWAYS AS (
                    CASE WHEN `active` = 1
                         THEN CONCAT(`citizenid`, '::', `job`)
                         ELSE NULL
                    END
                ) VIRTUAL
                AFTER `active`;
    END IF;
END$$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `anpr_all_flagged_plates` AS
SELECT
    ov.plate,
    ov.citizenid,
    lpw.title as reason,
    CASE
        WHEN lpw.priority = 'low' THEN 'LOW'
        WHEN lpw.priority = 'high' THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN lpw.priority = 'critical' THEN 'CRITICAL'
        ELSE 'MEDIUM'
    END as severity,
    lpw.created_by as officer,
    lpw.created_at as timestamp,
    'warrant' as source_type,
    lpw.warrant_status as status
FROM owned_vehicles ov
JOIN lbtablet_police_warrants lpw ON ov.citizenid = lpw.linked_profile_id
WHERE lpw.warrant_status = 'active'

UNION ALL
